messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

function.name: get_average_monthly_temperature
function.description: Retrieve the average monthly temperature of a location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location that you want to get the average monthly temperature for.

month.description: Month for which the average temperature needs to be fetched.

message.content:
The “sweet spot” for visiting Hawaii is usually **late spring (April–May) and early fall (September–October)**.  

| Month | Why it’s great |
|-------|----------------|
| **April** | Warm, sunny days (average high ~82 °F / 28 °C), lower crowds after the Easter holiday, and plenty of spring‑time events. |
| **May** | Still warm but slightly cooler than summer, fewer tourists, and great deals on accommodations. |
| **September** | Post‑summer lull, still warm (highs ~84 °F / 29 °C), and the start of the whale‑watching season on the Big Island. |
| **October** | Mild temperatures (highs ~81 °F / 27 °C), fewer crowds, and the tail end of the summer travel season. |

**Why avoid July–August?** Those are peak‑season months: higher prices, larger crowds, and the hottest temperatures (highs often >90 °F / 32 °C).  

If you’re looking for the best balance of pleasant weather, lower prices, and fewer crowds, aim for April, May, September, or October.
